_comment: Pinned identity of the OFFICIAL Blender Lab MCP used as this project's Blender backend.
This file is the single source of truth for the pin. Never use 'latest'.
discover -> compatibility suite -> security suite -> real Blender acceptance -> only then move the pin.

mcp_server.pypi_warning: PyPI 'blender-mcp' is a DIFFERENT community project (ahujasid/blender-mcp). Never pip install it.

blender_addon.required_for: interactive tools only (get_objects_summary, get_object_detail_summary, screenshots, jump_to_*)

integration_style: separate-process protocol integration over MCP stdio; never imported, never vendored, never forked

verified_blender.note: locally verified on Blender 5.2.2; upstream declares blender_version_min 5.1.0
